markdown_content: ## Overview of New Baby and Kid Avatar Assets in CLO 2025.0 This section introduces the new baby and kid avatar assets available in CLO 2025.0, including various ages, poses, and accessories. It highlights how these assets are organized within CLO’s library and Connect assets for easy access and use in creating detailed scenes. ## Baby and Kid Avatar Asset Library Organization The new baby and kid avatars in CLO are accessible through the asset library, which is divided into CLO assets and Connect assets: - **CLO Assets:** - Contains a dedicated baby section featuring avatars like Baby Juju. - Includes a variety of new poses for babies. - Offers basic accessories such as hair and shoes, which are familiar but still available here. - **Connect Assets:** - Provides additional baby poses expanding on the CLO library. - Contains more accessories specifically designed for babies, including hair and shoes. - Offers kid avatars with poses and accessories for a wider age range. ## Age Ranges and Character Examples The baby and kid avatars cover a broad spectrum of ages and characters: - **Babies:** - Baby River is shown progressing through different ages, from newborn stages up to toddler ages. - Baby Juju represents the classic baby avatar in the library. - **Kids:** - Avatars like Avery, Sasha, Melody, and Oliver span from 3 months through 24 months and beyond. - Age groups include: - 6 to 18 months - 2 to 6 years - 6 to 18 years (covering older children and youth) - Both male and female avatars are available for these age brackets. ## Poses and Scene Setup - The new avatars come with a range of poses suitable for babies and kids, allowing for highly expressive and dynamic scenes. - Users can mix and match poses and accessories to create natural, life-like scenarios within their CLO projects. - Motion elements are also included in Connect assets, enabling animated or dynamic presentations of the avatars. ## Accessories for Baby and Kid Avatars - Accessories include hair styles and shoes designed for babies and kids. - These accessories are available both within the CLO asset library and the Connect asset platform, offering flexibility in styling avatars. - The availability of these accessories supports creating varied and personalized looks for avatars across different stages of childhood. ## Summary CLO 2025.0 introduces a comprehensive set of baby and kid avatar assets with extensive pose options, age coverage from newborns to 18 years, and a wide array of accessories. These assets are organized across CLO’s built-in library and Connect assets, providing users with powerful tools to create detailed, realistic scenes featuring children at different developmental stages.
